about: Open textbooks brought in as published (python3 daybook.py learn-import). 'lessons': an unwritten outline lesson filled with these sections, word for word. 'originals': a lesson already written from these sections, which gains a link to them as published. Sections are numbered as in the book: 11.1 is chapter 11's first section. 'pages': an unwritten lesson filled from the other open and official sources in 'sources' (UK ones first), word for word; 'links': a written lesson's further reading from them, as published.
